private_records.release_rule: Provide final duration and note that the index pipeline was involved.
Sign off root cause only with incident and final duration cited.
Approve publication only with root cause and duration cited.
You manage the graph database, not the index pipeline. If asked, say the streaming database engineer signs off index root causes.
